FULL TEXT:
Department of Food Science & Technology
(NAAC Accredited Grade – A++)
University of Kashmir, Hazratbal Srinagar-190 006.
Date: 12-08-2026
Interview Notice
In continuation to the advertisement notice No: (Advertisement/ASEAN/)
FST/KU/2026, Dated: 28-07-2026, this is to inform to all candidates who
have applied for temporary position of RA-I available under the Indo-
ASEAN research project entitled “Redesigning of Fish from Fish
Protein Using Innovative 3D Printing” implemented by the
Department of Food Science and Technology, University of Kashmir,
in collaboration with:
Faculty of Fisheries and Food Science, Universiti Malaysia
Terengganu, and
Institute of Nutrition, Mahidol University, Thailand.
That the interview/interaction for the said post will be held on 14.08.2026
(Friday) at 10:30 AM onwards in the Department of Food Science &
Technology.
Therefore all candidates are informed to bring their CV & original
documents along with self attested photocopies. Furthermore, no TA/DA
will be paid for appearing in the
interview.
Sd/-
Dr. Adil Gani
Lead Principal Investigator
